svg.aria-label: DR103 · turret board layout (derived) — redrawn board layout diagram
svg.text: Redrawn from Four-input DR103 preamp drawing from serial number 903 ('HIWATT / Late 60s Four-Input Preamp / Preamp from DR103 S/N 903 / Drawing rev. 1.0 - Mark Huss') and the published early-1970s DR103 wiring diagram ('HIWATT DR103 LAYOUT, EARLY 1970'S', Mark Huss with updates from Jukka K., and Brian Haberman, 2007) — the board order here is derived from the circuit those two drawings between them state, because the wiring diagram's own board is a different value set (see the caption) — not a trace

Heater layer: the one part of this board not established against the amplifier's own drawing. At the centre-tapped valves (V1, V2, V3, V4) it shows the two heater pins on opposite supply legs — the 12.6 V series arrangement; a 6.3 V supply straps them into one leg and returns on the centre tap. Which sockets sit on the chain, and the order it reaches them in, are not affected.
Note: the 6.3 V heater twisted pair always routes on the top layer and never joins another run — its crossings are not hop-overs.
6.3 V heaters — twisted pair (leg grouping not established)
